_ordering_rationale: Hero metric REIT residentiel Cote Ouest: Core FFO/share + NOI + regional mix. Apartment homes en base operationnelle.

kpis.signal: Hero REIT metric, croissance reguliere 2022-2024 portee par rebond rents Cote Ouest post-COVID
kpis.description_fr: Core Funds From Operations par action diluee. Metrique hero pour REIT residentiel, exclut gains/pertes uniques et adjustements. Driver direct dividende et valorisation.
kpis.description_en: Core Funds From Operations per diluted share. Hero REIT residential metric, excludes one-off gains/losses and adjustments. Direct dividend and valuation driver.

kpis.signal: Croissance reguliere depuis 2022, +2,6% en 2024 sur SoCal +4,0% / NorCal +2,6% / Seattle +2,9%
kpis.description_fr: Net Operating Income des proprietes stabilisees comparables. Mesure organique purement operationnelle pour REIT, isole effet acquisitions/dispositions.
kpis.description_en: Net Operating Income from stabilized comparable properties. Pure organic operational measure for REITs, isolates acquisitions/dispositions effects.

kpis.signal: NOI total +6,1% en 2024, accelere par Non-Same-Property NOI 97 M$ (acquisitions, lease-up)
kpis.description_fr: NOI total portfolio consolide. Inclut Same-Property + Non-Same-Property (acquisitions, lease-up, dispositions). Reflet performance totale operationnelle.
kpis.description_en: Total consolidated portfolio NOI. Includes Same-Property + Non-Same-Property (acquisitions, lease-up, dispositions). Total operational performance.

kpis.signal: Croissance portefeuille +2 891 logements en 2024 via consolidations co-investments (BEXAEW, BEX II, Patina at Midtown, Century Towers)
kpis.description_fr: Nombre total de logements consolides en portefeuille. Mesure du sizing du portefeuille Essex, hors co-investments non consolides et developments en construction.
kpis.description_en: Total consolidated apartment homes in portfolio. Portfolio sizing measure, excludes non-consolidated co-investments and developments under construction.
kpis._verification_needed: FY20/FY21 valeurs ~60k a verifier dans 10-K 2021/2022 sections business overview
